Thanks Ben — sending a concise snapshot below from this morning's MAP standup. Attaching the two files (MAP_v1.2.pdf, eval-test-vectors.csv) and a short latency examples spreadsheet.

Summary (standup notes):
- Scope: 2-week POC using the LlamaX-13B-q8 variant in your us-west-2 tenant (isolated VPC).
- Acceptance criteria (must meet all):
  1) Functional: >= 95% pass rate on the curated eval set (see eval-test-vectors.csv)
  2) Latency: p95 <= 180ms, p99 <= 380ms for the 512-token profile
  3) Throughput: baseline sustained 60 reqs/sec at 75 concurrent sessions with KV cache priming
  4) Security: audit-log delivery to your S3 bucket and KMS-wrapped keys enabled
- Blockers currently tracked:
  - Acme service account must be provisioned for cross-account S3 write (owner: Sophie/Acme)
  - Perf harness needs 3rd test vector category (edge-case prompts) — owner: Diego
  - Quantized variant tuning pending if p95 target not met under load — owner: Rishi

Action items from today's MAP standup:
- Olga: share MAP_v1.2 and test vectors (attached) + Drive link [https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3MAPv12] (due: today)
- Diego Fernandez: add edge-case prompts to eval set and run first wave of perf tests (due: 2027-05-19)
- Rishi Malhotra: prepare quantized runtime build and latency comparison notes (due: 2027-05-20)
- Laura Bennett: coordinate canary rollout plan and writeup for acceptance checklist (due: 2027-05-21)

Meeting cadence: Weekly MAP check-in, Tuesdays 10am PT. Next sync: 2027-05-18 10:00 PT.

Attachments: MAP_v1.2.pdf (MAP doc), eval-test-vectors.csv (sample prompts + expected tags), latency-sla-examples.xlsx

--

Quick follow-up from my end. Diego will own the additional edge-case vectors (he's already drafted 40 prompts covering rare tokenization patterns). My notes:
- We'll run two perf passes: baseline (current runtime) and q8-quantized variant. If baseline p95 is above 180ms under the 75-concurrency profile, we will swap to the quantized build for the final acceptance run.
- Instrumentation: we'll push KV cache hit metrics and end-to-end trace IDs into your audit S3 (format defined in MAP_v1.2).
- Risk: network egress to your analytics stack could add ~15-30ms variance; recommend testing from your app tier as well.

Action updates:
- Diego: perf first wave (ETA 2027-05-19)
- Rishi: quantized build and latency comparison notes (ETA 2027-05-20)
- Laura: finalize acceptance checklist doc and share a one-page sign-off template (ETA 2027-05-21)

One-liner: we're on track for the acceptance window if the Acme service account and S3 write are enabled this week.

-rishi
